title: facts-course-v1

is_core.$comment: true if the catalog marks it a Texas Core Curriculum course

core_component_area.$comment: CB component-area code the course satisfies (CB010 Communication, CB020 Math, CB030 Life & Physical Sciences, ... CB090 Institutional); null if not a core course

tccn.$comment: Texas Common Course Number as printed (e.g. 'ENGL 1301'). Non-null => it IS a TCCN and transfers to any Texas public university, and the value is the equivalent code the target school maps to; null = catalog did not mark one. Answer still carries a verify-with-target-school disclaimer.

cb_approval_number.$comment: Coordinating Board Academic Approval Number as printed

campus_locations.$comment: campuses that offer the course, as printed (e.g. 'BHC, CVC, EFC, ...')

$comment: Starter contract (issue #36). Issue #51 finalizes and CI-pins it against the SQLAlchemy models. Nulls mean 'the source didn't say' - never invent values. Evolving a shape = copy to vN+1 and bump schema_version stamps.
